answer: To forge a sybil fleet an attacker must fake independent judgment, so make judgment the gate. Each identity posts a slashable bond and must forecast outcomes on a shared public atlas of verifiable real events every epoch. Honest agents disagree in useful ways; a farm sharing one backend emits a correlated signal the market detects, slashing the whole cluster. Faking N identities now costs N genuinely independent predictive edges plus N bonds at risk, not one cheap mint.
